key.name: window-is-maximized
key.summary: A flag to enable maximized mode

key.name: close-window-behavior
key.summary: Behavior when the window close button is pressed while playing

key.name: inhibit-suspend
key.summary: Inhibit automatic system suspend while audio is playing

key.name: gapless-playback
key.summary: A flag to enable gap-less playback

key.name: shuffle-separation
key.summary: Songs between two plays of a song when shuffling
key.description: With shuffle and repeat on, the minimum number of other songs that play before a song plays again.

key.name: ap-port
key.summary: Port to communicate with Spotify's server (access point). Setting to 0 (default) allows Canto to use servers running on any port.

key.name: volume-curve
key.summary: Volume slider curvature (log, linear, or cubic)

key.name: mono-audio
key.summary: Mix stereo audio to mono (both speakers play the same signal)

key.name: pan
key.summary: Stereo balance (-1.0 = full left, 0.0 = center, 1.0 = full right)

key.name: pitch-cents
key.summary: Pitch shift in cents (1 cent = 1/100 of a semitone; 0 = no shift)

key.name: feature-device-selector
key.summary: Enable the device selector in the Now Playing headerbar

key.name: feature-normalisation
key.summary: Show audio normalisation settings for fine-tuning loudness between tracks

key.name: feature-pinned-objects
key.summary: Enable pinning objects to the navigation panel

key.name: queue-side-panel
key.summary: Show the queue in the utility panel at the window's end, instead of the bottom sheet

key.name: app-language
key.description: Language used by the application interface ("system" follows the OS locale).

key.name: app-theme
key.summary: Selected color theme preset or Omarchy live theme

key.name: adaptive-cover-colors
key.summary: Subtly tint Now Playing and Lyrics surfaces with the active album art accent color

key.name: lyrics-offset-ms
key.summary: Manual synced lyrics timing offset in milliseconds

key.name: lyrics-highlight
key.summary: How the lyric line being sung lights up
key.description: "word" lights the words as they are sung; "line" lights the whole line at once.

key.name: lyrics-scroll
key.summary: What the lyrics do after scrolling them by hand
key.description: "follow" goes back to the line being sung a few seconds later; "free" stays where you left it until you press Back to Current Line.

key.name: player-bar-lyrics
key.summary: Show the Lyrics button in the player bar

key.name: player-bar-queue
key.summary: Show the Queue button in the player bar

key.name: player-bar-device
key.summary: Show the device (where the sound plays) button in the player bar

key.name: player-bar-volume
key.summary: Show the volume button in the player bar

key.name: player-bar-mini-player
key.summary: Show the Mini Player button in the player bar

key.name: player-bar-side-panel
key.summary: Show the side panel button in the player bar

key.name: player-bar-order
key.summary: Order of the buttons at the end of the player bar

key.name: navigation-rail
key.summary: Show the sidebar collapsed to covers and icons

key.name: pinned-objects-by-user
key.summary: JSON map of Spotify user ID to pinned objects (playlists, albums, artists, tracks)

key.name: card-layout
key.summary: Card layout style for library pages

key.name: sort-albums
key.summary: Sort order for saved albums page

key.name: sort-playlists
key.summary: Sort order for saved playlists page

key.name: sort-artists
key.summary: Sort order for saved artists page

key.name: drm-verified-user
key.summary: Spotify user id known to play tracks, used to skip PlayPlay DRM detection across restarts.

key.name: memory-cache-size-mb
key.summary: Maximum memory (MB) for the in-memory data and texture cache
key.description: Upper bound on RAM used to cache API responses and textures.

key.name: disk-cache-size-mb
key.summary: Maximum disk space (MB) for the on-disk data cache
key.description: Upper bound on disk space used to cache API responses.

key.name: audio-cache-size-mb
key.summary: Maximum disk space (MB) for the on-disk audio cache
key.description: Upper bound on disk space used to cache downloaded audio data.

key.name: lyrics-translation
key.summary: Show a translation under each lyric line

key.name: library-sort
key.description: "recents", "recently-added", "alphabetical" or "creator".

key.name: lyrics-translation-language
key.description: A language code like "en" or "ja"; "auto" uses the interface language.

key.name: google-translate-api-key
key.description: Optional. Without it, lyrics are translated through Google's free keyless endpoint, which may stop working.

key.name: genius-access-token
key.description: Optional Genius API client access token used to fetch verified song pages, credits, and liner notes.

key.name: scrobble-enabled
key.description: Submit now-playing updates and completed plays to configured scrobbling services.

key.name: scrobble-respect-remote
key.description: Include tracks played on remote Spotify Connect devices when scrobbling is enabled.

key.name: soloist-enabled
key.description: When librespot can't play this account, play through Spotify Soloist, Spotify's own headless player, instead of the hidden desktop app. Needs a Soloist API key.

key.name: lastfm-api-key
key.description: User-provided Last.fm API key for authentication and scrobbling.

key.name: lastfm-api-secret
key.description: User-provided Last.fm shared secret used to sign API requests.

key.name: lastfm-session-key
key.description: Session key obtained after authorizing Canto with Last.fm.

key.name: lastfm-session-rejected
key.description: Set when Last.fm rejects the session (access revoked on its site, or a new API key). Scrobbles wait in the queue until Canto is connected again.

key.name: lastfm-username
key.description: Display username of the connected Last.fm account.

key.name: listenbrainz-token
key.description: Personal ListenBrainz user token used to submit listens.

key.name: smart-queue-continuation
key.description: Automatically queue similar tracks when local playback reaches the end of the queue without repeat.

key.name: visual-bridge-enabled
key.description: Opt-in runtime JSON state and lock-free audio energy output for external visualizers such as Chaosphere.

key.name: migrated-from-riff
key.summary: Settings copied from the old app id
key.description: Set once the settings saved under dev.diegovsky.Riff (Canto's name before) have been copied over.
